content:
Overview

Yinchuan is a city in Ningxia with a population of 2,859,000. Capital of Ningxia, a walled city on the edge of the Gobi Desert, known for its Muslim Hui culture and wine-producing region. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
